title: Custom request statuses for help seekers
description:
Admins can now mask internal workflow statuses and display customer-friendly labels to help seekers on the request page. This ensures that while your team uses precise technical statuses to track work, customers see simplified, professional updates that are easy to understand. Go to your Customer Experience
	Select Form, then choose the form you want to edit.
	Locate the Customer status section to view your internal workflow statuses.
